scope: Deterministic first six packet codes E01-E06. Audit covers18slots; historical grading covers6slots only. Original DEV, not exam score.
independence: Owner arm aggregate46/57.5/57.5 was disclosed by root; no per-item owner grades, aggregate file or grading key read before this freeze. Packet codes hid arm during scoring; topics visible. Manifest/ledger metadata read but no key.
arithmetic_correction: After first-pass freeze, direct CKE p24 verification corrected error-count-as-deduction mistake. Historical/aspect judgments unchanged; original freeze retained. Official bands0/1/2/3 for0/1-2/3-5/>5errors. Original53 corrected57.

aspect_reasons: Political: emancipation and intensified repression are linked to shifts in power and solidarity; satisfactory causal development, not rich coverage.
Social: land ownership/status is connected to widening national participation; overstates a single turning point but explains a process.
Cultural: martyr memory and the move toward organic work are linked to preservation of identity; no specific literary example, but a mechanism is developed.
items.coherence_reason: Clear thesis, aspect paragraphs and connected conclusion; factual mistakes are handled separately. No unjustified format or wordcount penalty.
uncertainties: Sweeping claims that modern national community began only then are overcompressed and not treated as a separately established falsehood.

aspect_reasons: Political: treaty and legal/administrative consolidation support a stabilization argument.
Economic: monetary, urban and infrastructure changes are linked to trade and revenue.
Cultural: university foundation and building patronage are linked to administrative capacity and prestige.
items.coherence_reason: Clear thesis, aspect paragraphs and connected conclusion; factual mistakes are handled separately. No unjustified format or wordcount penalty.
established_errors: Accession is dated1335 despite the true1333 accession and the essay own introductory dates.
uncertainties: Monetary uniformity and attributing reunification entirely to this king are overstated; treated as uncertainty, not two extra certain errors.

aspect_reasons: Military: sabotage, intelligence and Burza have functional explanation; not rich evaluation of effectiveness or costs.
Political: courts/administration are named generically, but the claim of safeguarding post1945 sovereignty substitutes an incorrect outcome for a developed evaluation.
Social: clandestine education and publishing are connected to cultural survival and morale.
items.coherence_reason: Clear thesis, aspect paragraphs and connected conclusion; factual mistakes are handled separately. No unjustified format or wordcount penalty.
established_errors: Claims AK remained an organized army ready until the end of the war; formal dissolution was19January1945.
Claims PPP institutions protected Polish sovereignty after1945; the political structures were repressed/dissolved and independence was not restored.
uncertainties: Harem as a women organization and Zawisz as a youth organization need correction/verification; no extra central deduction solely from failed corroboration.
Policja Panstwowa terminology may mean underground PKB; do not count as a separate certain error.
Literal backslash-n residue is not an automatic coherence penalty.

aspect_reasons: Constitutional: hereditary rule and overcoming veto-type paralysis are linked to stronger decisions, despite one invented event.
Educational: KEN and Knight School are related to curricula and civic/administrative cadres.
International: pressure and weak military/alliances explain failure only generally, without a concrete diplomatic episode or decision.
items.coherence_reason: Clear thesis, aspect paragraphs and connected conclusion; factual mistakes are handled separately. No unjustified format or wordcount penalty.
established_errors: Invented Constitution of Lublin intervention in this eighteenth-century reform sequence.
uncertainties: Broad wording about ending noble freedom is interpreted as ending abusive mechanisms, not necessarily abolishing all legal privileges.

aspect_reasons: Military: sabotage/intelligence/Burza explain resistance and attempted restoration of control, although membership examples are unreliable.
Political: discussion rests on false political-group membership and an unsupported continuity outcome; superficial valid legalism core remains.
Social: education/publishing/welfare have a real causal connection to morale and solidarity despite an unverified operation name.
items.coherence_reason: Clear thesis, aspect paragraphs and connected conclusion; factual mistakes are handled separately. No unjustified format or wordcount penalty.
established_errors: SDKPi is an anachronistic component of the wartime underground political structure.
NZW is misrepresented as a political grouping constituting that structure; it was a later military formation, not a constituent party of the wartime representative body.
Central Powers structures are incorrectly listed as underground Polish political groupings.
Claims the underground apparatus provided ready state/local administration after the war, ignoring suppression and replacement of its political institutions.
uncertainties: Frontii Narodowych and Har-Har are unsupported labels, not independently established additional errors in this bounded pass.
NSZ was only partly integrated with AK; an unqualified example is imprecise, but not automatically an additional error.

aspect_reasons: Constitutional: changes are connected to decision-making and executive strength, though their scope is overstated.
Educational: curricula and cadre formation are linked to modernization; some terminology and institutional attribution are wrong.
International: geopolitical pressure and lack of effective support form a plausible but generic account without a concrete foreign-policy episode.
items.coherence_reason: Clear thesis, aspect paragraphs and connected conclusion; factual mistakes are handled separately. No unjustified format or wordcount penalty.
established_errors: Says the constitution eliminated noble privileges; its text explicitly protected many noble rights.
Attributes creation of a standing army to the constitution; an existing army was being reformed, not first created by this act.
Attributes abolition of Jesuit privileges to KEN; papal suppression preceded the commission taking over educational responsibilities.
uncertainties: Rokacji and ojczyznoparkowa are malformed terminology, not automatically separate historical events/errors.
